TemplateBody[] - it's array of templates. if you want get some template from there you need to do loop find
TemplateBodysByKey - it's object of templates. if you want to get some template from there you need to do TemplateBodysByKey[yourTemplateId] and you will get it without any loop findes

I should have been more clear 🤣 

I was talking about `loadingDb` and `isLoading` in the next two lines.
is this actually `templatesByKey` rather than `messagesByKey`?  It looks like a list of templates, rather than a list of messages.

issues.title: Swap templates for templateIds in channels
issues.body:
Early in the project we took a design decision to store the template definitions in the `channel` objects.  This means the `wargame` document contains all the data it needs.

But, we have a wargame with lots of long formatted messages. meaning the `channels` part of the wargame document is 34,000 lines long!

This can make the time to transmit (and parse) the wargame document longer, which could introduce the chance of `collisions` - which would crash SQLite.

There is also the down-side that if a message template layout is updated, the change isn't reflected in the wargame - since it will just use the version in place when the channel was created.

So, we should switch from storing the template to storing the template id (plus possibly the template name).  Storing the name means we can use a single template for different message types if the layout is the same.

If possible, I would like to keep some backward compatibility.  So, we can read/display wargames from the period when the wargame contained the template.  But, the game should ignore the template definition in the wargame and use the one from the `message-types` database.
